test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 02
subject: general
question: Which is of the following criteria is NOT the requirement for the appointment as a chairman/member of the Finance Commission?

options.text: Knowledge of inter-state relation and centre state relation

solution:
The correct answer is** **Option **3**.

 
• **Knowledge of inter-state relation** **and centre-state relation** is **not a desired criteria** for the members.
 
• The **Chairman** of a **Finance Commission** is selected from people with **experience in public affairs**.
 
• The other four members are selected from people who:
 
 
• Are, or have been, or are qualified, as **judges of a high court,**
 
• Have knowledge of government finances or accounts, or
 
• Have had experience in administration and financial expertise; or
 
• Have special **knowledge of economics**
